SYNTHETIC ENTEROSCOPY REPORT
Date of service: 03/14/2031
Endoscopist: Corvin Ashdale, MD (fictional)

History: The patient has an ileal J-pouch and a small gastric pouch after a Roux-en-Y gastric bypass.
Findings: The enteroscope was advanced through the gastric pouch and the Roux limb into the proximal ileum.
Biopsies of the proximal ileum were taken with cold forceps.
